Saved with a .js/.css extension so they are served with a script/style MIME type
(X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff would block a .cjs served as application/octet-stream).

To upgrade: download the same three files for a new exact version, verify the integrity hashes
from https://unpkg.com/<pkg>@<version>/dist/?meta, rename, and update saas/tracking/replay.py's
asset constants plus the admin replay template.
